payload.headline: Plans that share a path: drop both blocks and fix CHANGELOG and skill-surface merges at land in the same change?

parts.cause: Every merge on main since 2026-11-17 was replayed: 38 of 353 had a conflict. The mutation census had 37 (the land door regenerates it), plan files 19, CHANGELOG 2, hand-written source only 3 (2026-11-18/19). Land gates already run on the merged tree. Same-plan phases already cannot share a path in one wave. Gaps: the land door does not regenerate the skill surfaces, and CHANGELOG has no union merge rule.

options.cost: About 1 day. Contract check and test (~40 lines), portfolio.rs/wake.rs admission and tests (~60), .gitattributes 1 line, .fgos land.regenerate config, plan-contract and supervision spec text.
options.does: Overlap between plans becomes a warning naming the other plan and paths, at ready and at admission. In the same change, CHANGELOG.md gets a union merge rule and the generated skill surfaces join land.regenerate. The same-plan wave rule and the footprint write bound stay.
options.gain: No plan waits on another plan's late or generated file. No hand footprint edits, no whole-plan blockedBy as a workaround. Hot shared files merge themselves at land.
options.harm: A real conflict on hand-written source shows at land, and the lead rebases (3 cases in 353 merges).
options.label: A. Advice only, close land gaps

options.cost: About half a day, the two doors and their tests only.
options.does: Same as A without the CHANGELOG and skill-surface fixes.
options.gain: Smallest change, about half a day.
options.harm: Every plan that writes CHANGELOG or a skill gets land-conflict-aborted and a hand rebase. That cost moves from waiting to rework.
options.label: B. Advice only, nothing else

options.cost: About 1.5 days: A's land fixes plus a path classification shared by both doors.
options.does: Generated, declared and append-only files never block. Overlap on hand-written source still refuses ready and holds admission.
options.gain: Keeps a guard where a conflict needs a human.
options.harm: Plan 261126-0853 is still blocked (it shares supervision_verbs.rs and core/skills/** with running plans). A path list needs upkeep, and the measured risk it guards is small.
options.label: C. Block only hand-written source

options.cost: About 3 days, new admission logic per phase in the Rust supervisor.
options.does: A plan holds a path only while a phase that writes it is running, not for the plan's whole life.
options.gain: Keeps a block but much shorter.
options.harm: The supervisor must track phase state across plans and re-check at every phase start. A larger mechanism, close to the paused widening door.
options.label: D. Block by running phase only

parts.recommendation: A. The data shows conflicts at land are rare on hand-written source and the land gates already catch clean-merging breakage. The real cost today is waiting and hand edits. A also fixes the two files every plan touches, so dropping the block does not turn into rework.

scope.forbids: Touching plans 261125-2041 or 261125-1631, the widening door p-lfsc4czpgh, refresh-merge regeneration (p-avjhx3gxas), or automatic ordering of overlapping plans.

payload.headline: Plans that share a path: warn instead of block, and each change writes its own changelog file?

parts.cause: Replay of 353 merges on main since 2026-11-17: 38 conflicts, 37 on the mutation census (land door regenerates it), 3 on hand-written source. Land gates run on the merged tree; same-plan phases already cannot share a path in one wave. Gaps at land: skill surfaces are not regenerated, and CHANGELOG.md conflicts. A union merge on CHANGELOG would hide errors (a line silently landing under an already released version), so the standard fix is one small file per change.

options.cost: About 1.5 days: contract check and admission with tests (~100 lines), an assembly script and its test (~80), release recipe and land.regenerate config, AGENTS.md rule and plan-contract/supervision spec text.
options.does: Overlap between plans becomes a warning naming the other plan and paths, at ready and at admission. In the same change: each change adds one file under changelog.d/ instead of editing CHANGELOG.md, and the release step assembles them into the version section and deletes them; the generated skill surfaces join land.regenerate. The same-plan wave rule and the footprint write bound stay.
options.gain: No plan waits on another plan's late or generated file; CHANGELOG can no longer conflict and each entry travels with its change; no hand footprint edits.
options.harm: A real conflict on hand-written source shows at land and the lead rebases (3 in 353 merges). Every agent must learn the new changelog rule.
options.label: A. Warn only, changelog fragments

options.does: Same as A, but CHANGELOG.md keeps its [Unreleased] section with merge=union in .gitattributes.
options.gain: Half a day cheaper; no change to how agents write the changelog.
options.harm: Union merges silently: a line can land under a version already released, an edited line ends up twice, entries drift between sub-sections. Tests do not catch it.
options.label: B. Warn only, union merge for CHANGELOG

options.does: Drop both blocks, change nothing at land.
options.gain: Smallest change, about half a day.
options.harm: Most plans write CHANGELOG (91 commits touched it since 2026-11-17), so most lands meet land-conflict-aborted and a hand rebase: waiting turns into rework.
options.label: C. Warn only, nothing at land

parts.recommendation: A. You agreed to it in chat on 2026-11-26 23:11; this records it. It follows standard practice: no locks on text files, conflicts met in the merge queue, and the hottest shared file reorganized so it cannot conflict.

scope.allows: Settling ds-yf3vnbidi6 with A and handing it to a planner. The plan changes the contract check, the admission hold, the changelog convention (changelog.d/ plus assembly at release), land.regenerate, AGENTS.md and the plan-contract and supervision spec text.
scope.forbids: Touching plans 261125-2041 or 261125-1631, the widening door p-lfsc4czpgh, refresh-merge regeneration (p-avjhx3gxas), automatic ordering of overlapping plans, or rewriting CHANGELOG.md's released sections.

parts.what: Two doors stop a plan whose footprint shares a path with another active plan: the contract check refuses `ready`, and supervisor admission holds it (`held-footprint-overlap`). A file written once at the end, such as CHANGELOG.md, blocks other plans from day one. Worktrees and a merge queue (our land door) are built for the opposite: work in parallel, meet the conflict at merge.
